slug: 2026-02-09 Notification obligations arising from personal data breaches in Tanzania

facts.fact: Clyde & Co states that, with the enactment of the Personal Data Protection Act, Chapter 44, Revised Edition 2023, entities processing personal data in Tanzania are subject to breach-notification obligations (s.27(5)); no commencement date given, so the document's published date of 2026-02-09 is used.

Clyde & Co states controllers must notify the Personal Data Protection Commission of breaches and that the Commission provides a prescribed notification format; document's published date 2026-02-09 used.

systems.system: Personal Data Protection (Collection and Processing) Regulations, GN 449C of 2023
